title: Rhythm+Root Grand Opening
description: Join us for the grand opening of Rhythm+Root! Experience a night of incredible music, exclusive cocktails, and unforgettable vibes as we launch Baltimore's newest premier nightlife destination.

title: Friday Night Vibes
description: Every Friday night at Rhythm+Root features our resident DJs spinning the hottest tracks. Come dance the night away with complimentary entry before 11 PM.

title: Underground House Sessions
description: A curated night of deep house and techno featuring special guest DJs from NYC and Miami. Limited capacity for an intimate experience.
